Main
Today,the DCE iron ore futures showed weakness today. The most-traded DCE I2609 contract closed at 699.5 yuan/mt, down 0.43% from the previoustrading session. Spot prices at Qingdao Port rose by 4-9 yuan/mt from the prior trading day.
